optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample sources establish the candidate’s experience in planning onboarding projects, tracking milestones, reducing onboarding time, coordinating decisions, and documenting limitations. They do not provide evidence of production deployment, ownership beyond coordination, or any protected characteristic.

decisionBoundary.statement: Human review is required to assess fit for the Technical Project Manager role.

role.roleTitle: Technical Project Manager, Supply Chain Collaboration

evidence.text: Planned onboarding projects for twenty-three suppliers across two manufacturer customers, maintaining the milestone schedule (connectivity test, mapping sign-off, parallel run, go-live) for each supplier in the programme tracker.
evidence.notes: Direct statement of planning and milestone maintenance.

evidence.text: Tracked integration milestones with the three integration engineers, updating supplier status in the tracker each week, raising slipped milestones in the weekly project review and agreeing recovery dates with the supplier contact and the engineer concerned.
evidence.notes: Direct tracking and weekly status update.

evidence.text: Average supplier onboarding time fell from 46 days to 29 days across the seventeen suppliers onboarded after the standard mapping templates were introduced, as recorded in the programme tracker against the recorded baseline of 46 days for the first six suppliers.
Coordinated onboarding decisions with the programme lead and customer operations; the programme lead decided supplier sequencing and customer operations confirmed each go-live with the manufacturer.
Wrote the completion note for each onboarded supplier, listing open mapping limitations and the hand-over points for the support team.
evidence.notes: Direct documentation of limitations and hand-over.

humanReviewChecklist: Verify that the programme tracker export is accessible and contains the claimed baseline and onboarding days.
Confirm that the candidate personally introduced the standard mapping templates and that the reduction is attributable to their actions.
Ensure that the weekly project reviews were conducted as described and that the candidate recorded status updates in the tracker.
Clarify the extent of the candidate’s responsibility boundaries in coordination with the programme lead and customer operations.
